verdict.rationale: The vendor says it publishes accuracy results so buyers can evaluate transcription performance before integrating. That is the product's own capability for this story, but nothing shows the results come with a methodology, test dataset, or reproducible benchmark rather than headline numbers. missing for 10: documented benchmark methodology, named or downloadable evaluation dataset, metric definitions (e.g., WER) with per-language/condition breakdowns, independent or hands-on verification of the published figures.
